theater: 佩滕佩特什巴通河谷至蒂卡爾

battle.name: 第八次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 佩滕佩特什巴通河谷至蒂卡爾
battle.brief: 公元六七七年冬，拉科羅納城邦自佩滕佩特什巴通河谷出兵，越嶺東進，在星戰中攻破蒂卡爾城，擄走蒂卡爾君主雅什·努恩·阿欣一世，致這座低地最大的城邦沉寂數十年，多斯皮拉斯同時復國。卡面的秦弩從未現於中美洲；與它同位的是把力量存進器具裡的擲矛器，以及居高臨下壓住攻城者的台基射位。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場星戰在瑪雅古典期晚段的佩滕地區爆發，交戰的三方都是獨立的城邦政治體，沒有宣戰程序，兵員按盟約義務臨時徵集。進攻方是佩特什巴通河畔的拉科羅納：一個規模不大卻在六七二至六九二年間達到鼎盛的城邦，核心是晚期瑪雅最精緻的建築群，城內聚落據估計在數千人上下，卻靠控制佩特什巴通河谷的黑曜石、鹽、可可與獸皮商路維持強悍的兵制，骨幹是佩槍菁英與投射器隊。拉科羅納並非孤軍：多斯皮拉斯在同一場戰役中復國，國王努恩·烏卓爾·查克重新坐回佩滕西北的舊位，兩方在六七七年同時向蒂卡爾施壓，蒂卡爾的西線與腹地同時受敵。防守方是貝里斯凱奧區的蒂卡爾，低地最大的城邦，核心為東城區大廣場與四號神廟的高台，人口在數萬量級，防禦依賴台基頂端的射位、石階與狹窄的巷道。第三方有卡拉克穆爾、烏阿克通、卡拉科爾與納蘭霍，各懷算盤。
countriesEn: This star war broke out in the Peten region of the late Classic Maya period, and the three parties were all independent city-state polities with no declaration of war, their troops levied for the occasion according to alliance obligation. The attacker was La Corona, on the Petexbatun River: a city-state of no great size that reached its height between 672 and 692, whose core was the most refined architectural group of the late Maya, whose population is estimated at only a few thousand, and which nonetheless kept a formidable military by controlling the obsidian, salt, cacao and hide trade of the Petexbatun valley, with spearmen elites and missile teams as its backbone. La Corona did not fight alone: Dos Pilas was restored in the same campaign, its king Nuun Uchol Chaak (Nuun Ujol Chaak) resuming his seat in the north-west of the Peten, and the two together pressed Tikal in 677, hitting its western front and its heartland at one and the same time. The defender was Tikal in the Cayo District of Belize, the largest city-state of the lowlands, with its core at the Great Plaza of the East Acropolis and the high platform of Temple IV, a population in the tens of thousands, and a defence resting on the firing positions at the tops of the platforms, the stone stairways and the narrow lanes between the buildings. The third parties were Calakmul, Uaxactun, Caracol and Naranjo, each with its own arithmetic.
people: 能點名的人分屬三方。蒂卡爾一側最關鍵的名字是國王雅什·努恩·阿欣一世（Yax Nuun Ahiin I）：一般認為他正是在這場星戰中被俘，之後以俘虜身分度過數十年，直到七三四年前後才在囚禁中死去；他被擄走之後，蒂卡爾的立碑與王室祭祀幾近停擺，城邦靠攝政與王族旁支勉力維持，回復由花葉美洲豹（Foliated Jaguar）一系主持。多斯皮拉斯一側是復國的努恩·烏卓爾·查克，他利用拉科羅納的攻勢重掌舊位，兩年後卻在佩里一帶的大會戰中陣亡。拉科羅納的創基者與其後王的名字只能從殘碑讀出，通常歸入 K'inich Yax K'uh（鳥之美洲豹）一系，六七七年出兵的君主名號在現存殘碑上並不完整。除他們之外，替星戰定日的祭司兼天文官、抄寫戰果並把零刻上碑面的書記、率突擊隊上梯的貴族隊長、戴戰神面具出戰的菁英、處理俘虜贖金的中人，以及背運玉米與繩梯的勞役隊，都沒有留下名字。背景人物還有卡拉克穆爾的強人尤克努姆·切恩二世，他才是多斯皮拉斯背後的手。
peopleEn: The names that can be given fall into three groups. On the Tikal side the critical figure is the king, Yax Nuun Ahiin I, and it is generally held that he was precisely the man taken prisoner in this star war; he then spent decades as a captive and did not die until around 734, still in captivity. Once he was carried off, the monumental programme and the royal ritual calendar of Tikal almost stopped, the city was held together by a regent and cadet branches of the house, and the recovery was carried by the line of Foliated Jaguar. On the Dos Pilas side was the restored Nuun Uchol Chaak, who used the offensive of La Corona to retake his old position and who was killed two years later in the great battle around El Peru. The names of the founder of La Corona and of the kings after him can only be read from fragmentary monuments, and are usually placed in the line of K'inich Yax K'uh, the Bird Jaguar; the name of the ruler who took the field in 677 does not survive whole on the fragments. Around them stand many who left no name: the priest-astronomers who fixed the day of the star war, the scribes who wrote down the result and cut the zero onto the monument, the noble captains who led the ladders in the assault, the elites who fought wearing the masks of the war god, the middlemen who handled the ransoms of captives, and the porters who carried maize and rope ladders behind the army. Among the players in the background stands Yuknoom Ch'een II, the strong man of Calakmul, who was the hand behind Dos Pilas.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩（Chinese crossbow，約公元前二○○年，中原）從未出現在中美洲：弩臂的複合結構、蹶張的機括與金屬構件，沒有越過太平洋到達佩滕，它在本役只能當作一則技術上的對照物。功能上最接近它的是瑪雅的擲矛器（atlatl）與短弓：擲矛器同樣把人的力量存進器具裡，拋出時瞬間釋放，射程與準確度都勝過徒手投擲，而且體力較弱的人也能打出接近強壯者的射程，這正是弩在中原能讓守城一方壓住攻城者的道理。瑪雅的裝備分五層。第一層近戰：鑲黑曜石片的木柄棍劍 macuahuitl、石斧、木矛。第二層投射：擲矛器配加重前端的細長木矛、短弓與箭、石彈投石索。第三層防護：夾層棉甲 ichcahuipilli 配獸皮、木框蒙皮綴羽的圓盾 chictli。第四層攻城：木梯、繩索、破門斧與火攻草束，建築多為木構茅頂，一經點燃難以撲救。第五層後勤：沒有馭獸，糧秣、矛束與繩梯全靠人背，渡佩特什巴通河與聖巴托洛河改用獨木舟，主食是玉米、豆類、南瓜與鹹魚，可可作儀式交換。卡面那句「弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓」，在本役正是雙方火力結構的分野。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card (Chinese crossbow, about 200 BC, the Chinese plain) never reached Middle America: the composite limb, the trigger mechanism and the metal fittings of a crossbow did not cross the Pacific to the Peten, and in this campaign it can only serve as a technical comparison. The closest functional equivalents in the Maya world are the atlatl thrower and the short bow. The atlatl likewise stores a man's strength in an implement and releases it in an instant, giving both range and accuracy beyond a bare-handed throw, and a weaker hand can achieve close to the range of a strong one; that is exactly the argument for the crossbow in China, where a defending side could hold the attacker down. Maya equipment falls into five layers. First, close combat: the macuahuitl, a wooden club with obsidian blades set into the handle, stone axes, wooden spears. Second, missiles: the atlatl with its weighted slender dart, short bows and arrows, and stone-weighted throwing cords. Third, protection: the layered cotton armour ichcahuipilli worn over hide, and the round hide-framed feather-trimmed shield chictli. Fourth, siege: wooden ladders, rope, axes for breaking doors and bundles of burning thatch, since most buildings were timber-framed with thatched roofs and once lit could hardly be saved. Fifth, logistics: there were no draft animals, so grain, dart bundles and rope ladders all travelled on human backs, the Petexbatun and the San Bartolo rivers were crossed by canoe, the staple food was maize, beans, squash and salted fish, and cacao served ritual exchange. The line on the card, that the lock stores the pull and the rate of fire far exceeds that of the bow, was exactly the divide between the two firepower systems in this war.
tactics: 星戰有一套固定程序：先由祭司兼天文官依金星表與二六○日曆定下出征日，再在乾季開拔；遠征隊輕裝先鋒在前，糧秣隊與俘虜隊在後；接戰時以擲矛手在散兵線上反覆投射，弓手分佔兩翼，佩槍手以圓盾相接頂住守軍的躍前突擊，接近後改用木劍與石斧貼身廝殺，攻堅則靠梯與繩索攀上台基，再以火攻草束焚燒倉房與神殿。本役的關鍵不在正面強度，而在兩點。其一是高度：蒂卡爾的守軍佔著四號神廟與台基頂端的射位，居高臨下以擲矛器與短弓壓制城下的攻方，等於把弩手架在牆頭；攻方在牆下只能挨打，必須付出很大代價，才能把一條短程射界維持到攀梯的那一刻。其二是奪王：星戰的完成標準不是屠城，而是擒住對方君主或貴族，因此突擊隊的真正目標是王宮與王室居所；多斯皮拉斯的兵力同時在蒂卡爾西線施壓，把守軍主力吸在別處，才讓拉科羅納的隊伍得以直入核心。至於具體路線，碑銘沒有留下，可以確定的只是隊伍自西南方向進入，沿佩特什巴通河北上，再折東向蒂卡爾進逼。
tacticsEn: A star war followed a fixed procedure: priest-astronomers first fixed the day of departure from the Venus tables and the 260-day calendar, and the host moved off in the dry season; a light vanguard went in front, the grain train and the column of captives behind; on contact, atlatl throwers kept hurling from the loose line, archers took the flanks, spearmen locked shields together against the leaping assault of the defenders, and at close quarters they fought with wooden swords and stone axes, while the assault climbed the platforms with ladders and rope and then fired the storehouses and the temples with bundles of burning thatch. What decided this campaign was not weight of force but two things. The first was height: the defenders of Tikal held the firing positions at the top of Temple IV and the other platforms and rained atlatl darts and arrows down on the attackers in the open, which is the equivalent of putting crossbowmen on the wall; the attackers could only take what came down on them and had to pay dearly to hold even a short line of fire up to the moment the ladders went up. The second was the taking of the king: the completion of a star war did not mean the sack of the city but the capture of the opposing lord or his nobles, so the real objective of the assault columns was the palace and the royal residences; while Dos Pilas pressed the western front of Tikal and drew the main body of the defenders away, the columns of La Corona were able to strike straight into the core. As for the route, the inscriptions say nothing; what can be established is only that the host entered from the south-west, moved north along the Petexbatun and then turned east towards Tikal.
data: 可引的數字集中在幾處。第一是曆法：整批星戰銘文共記十三場，橫跨五六二至七八一年；其中約七成的日期對應金星的昏星相位，而這七成之中又有八成四對應昏星初現；季節上十一月至翌年一月的乾季最密集，九月中至十月下旬的收穫期完全沒有記錄，以長紀曆換算，六七七年大致落在 9.12.10 這個卡敦段內，因此本役的月份只能依乾季分布置為十二月，屬約數。第二是地理：拉科羅納在佩滕的佩特什巴通河畔，約北緯十六度三十二分、西經八十九度五十二分；蒂卡爾在約北緯十七度十三分、西經八十九度三十七分，兩地直線相距約八十公里，沿商道繞行更遠。第三是規模：蒂卡爾四號神廟通高約六十五公尺，東城區大廣場約一百乘八十公尺；遠征兵力沒有可靠數字，學界對這類星戰給出的寬鬆區間是數千名戰士，其中佩槍的貴族菁英通常只有數十至數百人。第四是年表：拉科羅納的興盛期約六七二至六九二年，其城於六九二年前後被焚而廢棄；多斯皮拉斯六七七年復國，六七九年在佩里一帶敗於蒂卡爾，至七三一年前後陷落；被俘的蒂卡爾君主直到七三四年前後才在囚禁中死去。損耗數字沒有來源可以支撐，只宜說兩城各有相當數量的建築被焚、村社人口外流。
dataEn: The figures that can be cited fall into a few groups. First, the calendar: the whole corpus of star-war inscriptions records thirteen engagements spread across 562 to 781; about seventy percent of their dates correspond to the evening phase of Venus, and eighty-four percent of those correspond to the first appearance of the evening star; as for season, the dry season from November into January is the densest, and there is no record at all in the harvest window from mid-September to late October. Converted into the Long Count, the year 677 falls roughly inside the katun 9.12.10, so the month assigned to this campaign can only be placed by the dry-season pattern, in December, and that is an approximation. Second, geography: La Corona stands on the Petexbatun River in the Peten at about 16 degrees 32 minutes north, 89 degrees 52 minutes west; Tikal lies at about 17 degrees 13 minutes north, 89 degrees 37 minutes west, and the two are roughly eighty kilometres apart in a straight line, further if the trading road is followed. Third, scale: Temple IV at Tikal stands about sixty-five metres high, and the Great Plaza of the East Acropolis measures roughly one hundred by eighty metres. There is no reliable figure for the size of the host; scholarship puts such star wars in the loose range of several thousand warriors, of whom the spearmen elite was usually only some dozens to some hundreds. Fourth, the chronology: La Corona's period of ascendancy ran from about 672 to 692, and its city was burned and abandoned around 692; Dos Pilas was restored in 677, lost at El Peru in 679 and fell around 731; and the Tikal lord taken prisoner did not die until around 734, still in captivity. As for losses, no source supports any number, and the only safe statement is that substantial numbers of buildings in both cities were burned and that population moved out of the villages.
cause: 打起來有幾層原因。最表面的是六七○年之後佩滕權力格局的塌陷：多斯皮拉斯打敗蒂卡爾，蒂卡爾在西線的附庸與據點被逐一挖走，西部邊境出現真空，拉科羅納正坐落在這條真空帶的南端。第二層是商路與山口：佩特什巴通河谷的黑曜石、鹽、可可與獸皮是低地西部最值錢的交換骨架，誰控制渡口與山徑，誰就抽得了稅；拉科羅納要成為真正的強者，就必須把這條線握在自己手裡，而不是繼續從蒂卡爾的秩序裡分貨。第三層是復國的時機：多斯皮拉斯的國王六七七年復位，需要一個蒂卡爾無力反擊的窗口，而拉科羅納的星戰恰好提供了這個窗口，卡拉克穆爾的強人尤克努姆·切恩二世樂見其成。第四層是儀式：王權需要一場走完的星戰來確認正統，把對手從宇宙秩序裡抹去；星戰的義務一旦由星辰指派，就不容拖延。史料留下空白的地方不少：拉科羅納此時是否仍是蒂卡爾的盟邦、蒂卡爾內部是否另有勢力縱容了這一擊，碑銘都沒有說明，這場背叛的動機至今仍是學界爭論的焦點。
causeEn: There were several layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was the collapse of the balance of power in the Peten after 670: Dos Pilas beat Tikal, the western client states and outposts of Tikal were picked off one by one, a vacuum opened along the western frontier, and La Corona sat at the southern end of that vacuum. One level deeper lay the trade roads and the passes: the obsidian, salt, cacao and hides of the Petexbatun valley formed the most valuable exchange skeleton in the western lowlands, and whoever held the fords and the mountain paths collected the toll; for La Corona to become a genuine power it had to keep that line in its own hands instead of continuing to take a share out of Tikal's order. One level deeper again was the moment of restoration: the king of Dos Pilas returned to his seat in 677 and needed a window in which Tikal could not strike back, and the star war of La Corona supplied exactly such a window, while Yuknoom Ch'een II of Calakmul was glad to see it. Last of all came the ritual layer: kingship needs a star war carried through to the end to confirm its legitimacy and rub the enemy out of the order of the world, and an obligation assigned by the stars cannot be put off. The sources leave a good deal blank: whether La Corona was still an ally of Tikal at that moment, and whether some interest inside Tikal connived at the blow, are not recorded on the monuments, and the motive for the betrayal remains a point of dispute among scholars.
impact: 直接效果是低地權力版圖的一次劇烈反轉。蒂卡爾自六七七年起陷入漫長的停滯：國王被擄走，王室祭祀與立碑節奏中斷，數十年間靠攝政維持一座沒有國王的城，直到七三四年前後才恢復對外的宣示；蒂卡爾把西線與佩滕的宗主權一併丟失，此前它仍是低地最大的城邦。此後的連鎖反應清楚：多斯皮拉斯在佩里一帶的大敗只是把矛盾推回原點，佩滕的重心再度擺回蒂卡爾一側；烏阿克通與卡拉克穆爾的聯手把西部拖成消耗戰；直到賈索·錢·卡維爾一世在七三一年前後攻陷多斯皮拉斯，蒂卡爾才重新取得西部的樞紐。但勝利者自己並沒有好下場：拉科羅納的興盛期只維持到六九二年前後，其城被焚而廢棄，原因在記錄裡完全空白，勝者與敗者一樣從地圖上退場。星際大戰的編號因此不是一份勝負表，而是一串被打斷又重新接續的年代史，第八次是其中轉折最明顯的一次。
impactEn: The immediate effect was a violent reversal in the map of the lowlands. Tikal was locked into a long stagnation from 677 onward: the king was carried off, the rhythm of royal ritual and monument raising was broken, and for decades a city without a king was held together by a regent, not resuming its public claims until around 734; Tikal lost at one stroke its western front and its standing as overlord of the Peten, having until then been the largest city-state of the lowlands. The chain of consequences that followed is clear. The great defeat around El Peru inflicted on Dos Pilas only pushed the quarrel back to where it started, and the centre of gravity in the Peten swung back to the Tikal side; the combination of Uaxactun and Calakmul turned the west into a war of attrition; and only when Jasaw Chan K'awiil I took Dos Pilas around 731 did Tikal recover the hinge of the western half. The victors, however, did not fare well either: La Corona's ascendancy lasted only until about 692, when its city was burned and abandoned for reasons entirely blank in the record, so the conqueror vanished from the map just as the conquered had. The numbering of the star wars is therefore not a score sheet but a chronicle of interrupted and resumed decades, and the eighth of them is the one in which the turn is clearest.
result: 結果是拉科羅納與多斯皮拉斯聯手得勝，蒂卡爾敗。遠征隊深入佩滕核心，在星戰中攻入蒂卡爾城，奪走國王雅什·努恩·阿欣一世，把蒂卡爾的立碑與祭祀連同它對西線的宗主權一起擱下；多斯皮拉斯趁勢復國，國王重回舊位，佩滕的兩面同時受挫於同一場戰役。對蒂卡爾而言這不是慘敗而是一場政體層面的重創：城未必盡毀，神廟的骨架多半仍在，但沒有國王的城邦在瑪雅世界裡等於失去了時間與正統，連帶六九五年與七○五年兩次星戰的失敗，都要從這一年的俘虜算起。對拉科羅納而言，這是它存在的頂點：城邦在六七二至六九二年的黃金歲月由此打開，卻在六九二年前後被火焚廢棄，勝者自己成為下一段空白。放到整批十三場星戰裡看，第八次正是低地最盛期的頂點與轉折點：它拆掉的是蒂卡爾，此後四十年裡，佩滕、貝里斯與瓦卡台地先後換了主人，而每一次換手，都要從一場星戰算起。
resultEn: The result was a victory for La Corona and Dos Pilas together and a defeat for Tikal. The expedition drove deep into the heart of the Peten, entered Tikal in a star war, carried off the king Yax Nuun Ahiin I, and laid low at one stroke both the monumental and ritual life of Tikal and its overlordship of the western half; Dos Pilas took the chance to be restored, its king resumed his old seat, and both faces of the Peten were struck down in the same campaign. For Tikal this was not a rout but a wound at the level of the polity: the city may not have been levelled and much of the skeleton of its temples was still standing, but a city-state without a king had lost, in the Maya world, both its time and its legitimacy, and the failures of 695 and 705 both have to be reckoned from the captive taken in this year. For La Corona this was the high point of its existence: the golden years of 672 to 692 opened with it, yet the city was burned and abandoned around 692, and the victor himself became the next blank in the record. Placed in the whole corpus of thirteen star wars, the eighth is both the summit and the turning point of the lowlands' most prosperous age: what it pulled down was Tikal, and over the following forty years the Peten, Belize and the Vaca Plateau changed hands one after another, and every one of those handovers began with a star war.
